baseline_source.text: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל עֲוֺנִ֖/י מִ/נְּשֹֽׂא־׃

baseline_english: And Cain said to Yahweh[a], “My iniquity is too great to bear.”

baseline_revisions.from: And Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.”
baseline_revisions.to: And Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.”
baseline_revisions.rationale: Revised 'punishment' to 'iniquity' to reflect the primary sense of עָוֹן here more directly, while keeping the clause natural and formally appropriate. Retained 'to bear' for נְשֹׂא.
